title: Perion to Announce Third Quarter Financial Results on Monday, November 16, 2026
summary: New York & Tel Aviv, July 20, 2026 – Perion Network Ltd. (NASDAQ & TASE: PERI), an advanced technology leader solving for the complexities of digital
body_markdown:
*Following Announcement of Definitive Merger Agreement with Affle, No Earnings Conference Call Will Be Held Company Withdraws Previously Issued Financial Guidance*


**New York & Tel Aviv – November 2, 2026** –[Perion Network Ltd](http://www.perion.com/) . (NASDAQ and TASE:[PERI](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/peri) ), an advanced technology leader solving for the complexities of digital advertising through AI-native execution infrastructure, today announced it will release its third quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 16th before the U.S. stock market opens. In light of the recently announced definitive merger agreement with Affle 3i Limited (“Affle”), the Company will not hold a conference call to discuss its results.


**Transaction with Affle:**


On November 1, 2026, Perion entered into a definitive merger agreement with Affle. Under the terms of the agreement, Affle will acquire all of the outstanding shares of Perion for $11.70 per share in an all-cash transaction for an equity value of approximately $420 million. This represents a premium of 34.5% to Perion’s closing stock price on October 30, 2026, the last full trading day prior to the transaction announcement. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027, subject to closing conditions, including approval by Perion shareholders.


**Full-Year 2026 Outlook:**


Given the announced transaction, Perion is withdrawing its full-year 2026 outlook, provided on August 10, 2026, and all other previously issued financial outlook and targets, including its 2028 targets. Perion does not intend to provide financial guidance while the transaction is pending.


**Share Repurchase Program:**


In November 2025, Perion’s Board of Directors approved a $75 million expansion of the previously authorized share repurchase program of $125 million of its outstanding shares, to a total of $200 million. As of October 30, 2026, under the authorized share repurchase plan, the Company repurchased a total of 21.3 million shares for a total amount of $196.8 million.


In connection with the pending transaction, Perion has suspended its share repurchase program.


The earnings press release and accompanying financial data tables will be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the company’s website at:[https://perion.com/investors/](https://perion.com/investors/)


**About Perion Network Ltd.**


Perion is an advanced technology leader redefining advertising through AI-native infrastructure, delivering real-time media execution across CTV, digital out-of-home, commerce and retail media, social and digital environments. Powered by Outmax, the company’s proprietary AI engine, Perion helps brands, agencies, and retailers optimize spend and performance, driving measurable outcomes at scale.


For more information, visit[www.perion.com](http://www.perion.com/)
